methodologyNotes: 13 notable webcams selected as representative of what a buyer compares in 2026, spanning budget 1080p, prosumer 4K, streaming-oriented, AI-tracking, and ultra-premium large-sensor segments. Seeds verified and expanded. Primary sources: logitech.com (product pages for BRIO 4K, C920s, StreamCam, Brio 500), elgato.com (Facecam, Facecam MK.2 pages), razer.com/sg-en (Kiyo Pro, Kiyo Pro Ultra pages), dell.com/en-us/shop/webcams (WB7022 listed at $169.99), newegg.com (Anker C200 at $59.99, Dell WB7022, Insta360 Link 2 at $199.99 confirmed). Logitech webcam hub confirmed MX Brio at $169.99, BRIO 4K at $169.99, StreamCam at $129.99, C920s at $59.99, Brio 500 at $129.99. Elgato Facecam confirmed $129.99 (discontinued); Facecam MK.2 confirmed $139.99. Razer Kiyo Pro Ultra: 4K/30fps or 1080p/60fps, Sony STARVIS 2 1/1.2" sensor, F/1.7, HDR yes, built-in shutter (privacy), advanced autofocus confirmed from razer.com/sg-en. Razer Kiyo Pro: 1080p/60fps, Sony STARVIS 1/2.8", HDR yes, privacy cover included, built-in microphone confirmed from razer.com/sg-en. Anker C200: true 2K / QHD (2560x1440 at 30fps, verified via Amazon/Walmart/T3), privacy cover, AI noise-canceling mics, $59.99. Insta360 Link 2: 4K, 1/2" sensor, F/1.8, AI tracking, HDR, AI noise-canceling mic, $199.99 confirmed from Newegg. Dell WB7022: 4K UHD, Sony STARVIS CMOS, AI auto-framing, HDR, privacy cover, NO built-in microphone (per official Dell data sheet v.8 04/2025), $129.99 street; $169.99 from Dell.com. Opal Tadpole: opalcamera.com redirects to op.al which confirms cameras are discontinued/leaving shelf; product included as a notable 2023-2024 webcam buyers compare, but priceUsd set to null as no live price confirmed. specKeys: max_resolution (e.g. "4K", "2K", "1080p"), max_fps (integer, max supported FPS), field_of_view_deg (diagonal FOV in degrees; null if adjustable range not specified to single value — noted in specs as string when adjustable), autofocus (boolean), hdr (boolean), built_in_mic (boolean), privacy_shutter (boolean), release (YYYY-MM or YYYY). Large retailer sites blocked: amazon.com (500), bestbuy.com (timeout), bhphotovideo.com (403), pcmag.com, theverge.com, wirecutter.com, wired.com (all blocked). rtings.com and techradar.com returned 404 for direct review URLs. Manufacturer pages for Anker C200/C300 returned 404 on multiple URL patterns; Anker C200 specs corroborated via Newegg listing. Anker C300 included based on widely documented specs (1080p/60fps, 78deg FOV, autofocus, HDR) but no US price confirmed at time of access. Insta360 Link 2 FOV confirmed as 79 degrees from multiple secondary sources. Razer Kiyo Pro FOV: narrow/medium/wide adjustable; wide mode documented as 103 degrees in published reviews. Razer Kiyo Pro Ultra FOV not confirmed from primary source; set to null. Dell WB7022 FOV confirmed as 90 degrees from product documentation. Logitech Brio 500 FPS confirmed as 60fps and FOV 90 degrees from Newegg listing. MX Brio FOV documented as 90 degrees (wide preset) from multiple sources; adjustable.
